literal_meaning: কথায় (in words/talk) কথায় (in words/talk) – word-by-word repetition indicating ongoing conversation
figurative_meaning_en: In the course of conversation or incidentally through talk
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথায় কথায় জানলাম তুমি গান জানো।
কথায় কথায় তার পরিচয়টা বেরিয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: In the course of conversation, I learned that you know how to sing.
Through casual talk, his identity came to light.
note: This is a classic example of Bengali reduplication (দ্বিত্বশব্দ) used to convey continuity or casual progression in speech.
